jszip.min.js in this folder is JSZip 3.10.1 (npm jszip 3.10.1, dist/), unchanged (https://github.com/Stuk/jszip).
Same bytes as cdnjs ajax/libs/jszip/3.10.1, checked against cdnjs's SRI hash and the npm package on 2026-11-10:
  jszip.min.js  sha256 acc7e41455a80765b5fd9c7ee1b8078a6d160bbbca455aeae854de65c947d59e
SlimIO serves it itself so a tool never breaks when a CDN is slow or blocked; it builds ZIP downloads in the
visitor's browser. The bundled pako notice is kept in the file's header comment.

JSZip is dual licensed (MIT or GPLv3); SlimIO uses it under the MIT license.
